name: Safety Bollards

count.label: Posts
count.desc: How many posts in the row. They run along local X from the part origin.

spacing.label: Spacing (m)
spacing.desc: Centre-to-centre gap between posts. Set it narrower than whatever you mean to keep out, since the posts stop nothing that fits between them.

height.label: Height (m)
height.desc: Height of each post above the floor.
